answer.reason: Different business model: Wendy’s serves made-to-order restaurant meals to diners through drive-thru and delivery, while Seneca processes and distributes fruit and vegetable products for retail, foodservice, international and industrial markets. Their shared food-sector presence does not establish comparable offerings or buyers.
answer.missing_evidence: No material evidence gap for this conclusion; the passages establish distinct offerings, sales channels and business models.
